purpose: Pinned fill of source_date, the day the report itself was posted, on every surviving counted OBS Studio row that had none. Only that one line changes per row; captured_at, counted, exclusion_reason, the identity and every other byte stay, and no acceptance field is set.
format: YYYY-MM-DD, the UTC day of the source's own creation timestamp

kinds.github_issue: the issue's created_at (REST), never updated_at or closed_at
kinds.github_issue_comment: the comment's own created_at, never its parent issue's
kinds.forum_opening_post: the first <time> inside the opening post's own article, never the page's last activity
kinds.forum_reply: the <time> inside the reply's own article, never the opening post's

not_dated.reason: withdrawn as a same-page duplicate by live_citation_withdrawal_v2.json (AUX-090), so not a surviving counted row

note: Each entry must match exactly one stored block whose sha256 equals block_sha256_before (to date) or block_sha256_after (already dated). Sources were read once each, sequentially, from the public GitHub REST API and the OBS forum thread pages.
